build_ImageCropper: build an ImageCropper module that crops images around a modal mask with padding and rescaling
create_extract_box_from_mask: create a function that extracts bounding box coordinates from a binary mask numpy array
create_crop_and_make_square_padding: create a function that crops images by bounding box and pads them to make square tensors
